mainEntity.name: What does a website development agency do?

acceptedAnswer.text: A website development agency plans, designs, builds, tests, and maintains websites and web applications. Its work may include frontend development, backend programming, CMS configuration, eCommerce functionality, integrations, and technical optimization.

mainEntity.name: How much does website development cost in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Website development costs in India depend on the website type, design complexity, number of pages, functionality, integrations, and technology requirements. A basic business website generally requires a smaller investment than a custom web application or complex eCommerce platform. Openink Hub can provide a quotation after understanding your requirements.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to develop a website?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline depends on project scope, design approvals, content readiness, integrations, and functionality. A relatively simple business website may take less time than a custom application or large eCommerce platform. A realistic timeline can be established after project discovery.

mainEntity.name: Will my website work on mobile devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our website planning considers responsive layouts so the website can adapt to different screen sizes, including smartphones, tablets, and desktop devices.

We consider SEO fundamentals such as website structure, metadata, heading hierarchy, mobile usability, crawlability, indexability, and performance. Ongoing SEO campaigns and ranking improvements are separate activities that may be planned according to your goals.

mainEntity.name: Which technology is best for website development?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single technology that is best for every website. WordPress may be appropriate for content-driven business websites, while React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, or other technologies may suit projects requiring custom functionality. The right choice depends on your requirements and long-term plans.

mainEntity.name: Can you develop an eCommerce website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. eCommerce projects can include product catalogues, categories, shopping carts, checkout processes, payment gateway integrations, and order management features, depending on the agreed project scope.

mainEntity.name: Can my website be connected to WhatsApp?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Depending on your requirements, your website can be connected to WhatsApp for customer enquiries, communication, lead capture, and automation using supported integration methods.

mainEntity.name: Can you redesign my existing website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A redesign project can involve updating the visual design, improving navigation, restructuring content, optimizing mobile layouts, and modernizing technical components.
Website maintenance can be planned as a separate service. It may include software updates, backups, security checks, technical troubleshooting, content updates, and performance monitoring.

mainEntity.name: Can you develop a custom web application?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Custom web application projects can be evaluated based on their workflows, user roles, integrations, database requirements, security considerations, and functional specifications.

mainEntity.name: Why should I choose Openink Hub?

acceptedAnswer.text: As a website development company, Openink Hub combines website development with digital growth and automation capabilities. This allows businesses to consider their website, search visibility, customer communication, and lead management as connected parts of their digital strategy.

content_html:
Website Development • Openink Hub

Website Development Agency for Businesses Ready to Grow

Build a powerful digital presence with websites designed to attract visitors, generate leads, and support business growth.

Your website should do more than look good. It should communicate your value, build customer trust, perform smoothly across devices, and turn visitors into business opportunities.

At Openink Hub, a website development agency based in Ranchi, India, we help startups, small businesses, growing companies, and established brands build modern websites and digital experiences. Our website design and development work ranges from business websites and eCommerce platforms to custom web applications, combining thoughtful design, reliable development, SEO-friendly architecture, and intelligent automation.

Whether you are looking for a website development company to launch a new business, replace an outdated website, or build a more advanced digital platform, our team can help turn your ideas into a functional online experience. We provide website development in India for businesses at every stage.

A website development agency plans, designs, builds, tests and maintains websites and web applications for businesses. Openink Hub builds business websites, custom websites, eCommerce stores, WordPress sites and web applications in India, with SEO-friendly structure, responsive layouts and automation-ready integrations for lead capture and customer communication.

Build your website with Openink Hub.

Get a Free Consultation → Discuss Your Project →

Services

Website Development Services That Support Your Business Goals

Every business has different website requirements. We develop digital solutions around your audience, business model, operational needs, and future growth plans.

01

Business Website Development

Establish a professional online presence with a website that clearly communicates your services, business strengths, and value proposition.

We develop business websites that help customers understand what you offer, explore your solutions, and contact your team.

What we can build:

  • Corporate and company websites
  • Small business websites
  • Startup websites
  • Professional service websites
  • Agency and portfolio websites
  • Multi-section business websites

02

Custom Website Development

When standard templates cannot support your requirements, custom website development gives you greater flexibility.

We create tailored website functionality, user experiences, and integrations based on your business requirements.

Custom development capabilities:

  • Custom website layouts and components
  • Interactive website functionality
  • Third-party API integrations
  • Custom forms and enquiry systems
  • User dashboards and portals
  • Business-specific features and workflows

03

eCommerce Website Development

Create an online store that makes it easier for customers to discover products, understand your offerings, and complete purchases.

We help businesses develop eCommerce experiences focused on usability, product presentation, and smooth shopping journeys.

eCommerce development includes:

  • Online store design and development
  • Product and category management
  • Shopping cart functionality
  • Checkout integration
  • Payment gateway integration
  • Order and customer management
  • Mobile-friendly shopping experiences

04

WordPress Website Development

Build and manage your website using a flexible content management system.

WordPress can be suitable for businesses that want to publish articles, manage website content, create service sections, and expand their digital presence.

WordPress solutions include:

  • WordPress business websites
  • Custom theme development
  • Theme customization
  • Plugin configuration
  • Blog and content management
  • Website migration
  • WordPress maintenance

05

Web Application Development

Take your business beyond a conventional website with custom web applications designed around specific operational requirements.

We can help plan and develop web-based tools that support your customers, employees, and business processes.

Potential applications include:

  • Customer portals
  • Admin dashboards
  • CRM-connected applications
  • Booking and appointment systems
  • Lead management systems
  • Reporting dashboards
  • SaaS platforms and business tools

06

Website Redesign and Modernization

An outdated website can make it difficult for customers to understand your business or take the next step.

We help modernize existing websites through improved layouts, navigation, mobile usability, content structure, and technical performance.

Website redesign services include:

  • Website UI/UX improvements
  • Visual redesign
  • Mobile responsiveness
  • Navigation restructuring
  • Content presentation improvements
  • Website speed optimization
  • SEO-conscious website migration

Technology

Our Website Development Technology Stack

The right technology depends on the purpose, complexity, scalability requirements, and maintenance needs of your project.

We consider modern development technologies and platforms across the following areas.

Frontend Development

  • HTML5
  • CSS3
  • JavaScript
  • React
  • Next.js
  • Responsive UI development

Backend Development

  • Node.js
  • PHP
  • Python
  • REST API development
  • Backend business logic

CMS and eCommerce

  • WordPress
  • WooCommerce
  • Custom CMS solutions
  • eCommerce integrations

Database and Data Management

  • MySQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • MongoDB
  • Database architecture and integration

Cloud and Deployment

  • Cloud hosting environments
  • Domain and hosting configuration
  • Deployment workflows
  • SSL configuration
  • Backup and maintenance planning

The final technology stack is selected according to your project requirements. Specific frameworks, integrations, and infrastructure are subject to technical assessment.

Search and AI

Websites Designed for Search Engines and AI Discovery

A beautiful website is only one part of a successful digital presence. Your website should also be structured so search engines and AI-powered discovery systems can understand its content.

At Openink Hub, we consider search visibility during website planning and development. SEO-friendly website development means building the structure, content and technical foundations that search engines need from the start.

SEO-Friendly Website Architecture

We create clear content structures, logical navigation, descriptive URLs, and heading hierarchies that make website content easier to understand and navigate.

SEO services →

Technical SEO Readiness

Our development approach considers:

  • Search engine crawlability
  • Indexability configuration
  • XML sitemap readiness
  • Robots.txt configuration
  • Canonical URL implementation
  • Structured data opportunities
  • Mobile usability
  • Page loading performance

GEO – Generative Engine Optimization

We structure useful, clearly written website content to improve its accessibility and understandability for AI-powered search experiences.

Generative engine optimization →

AEO – Answer Engine Optimization

We organize relevant information, definitions, service explanations, and FAQs so users and answer engines can identify direct answers to common questions.

Answer engine optimization →

Performance and User Experience

We consider page speed, responsive layouts, accessibility, navigation, and usability as important parts of website quality.

Our goal is to build websites that work for visitors while providing a strong foundation for ongoing SEO, AEO, and GEO activities.

Growth

Turn Your Website Into a Business Growth Engine

Your website can become the central point connecting your marketing, customer communication, and business operations.

Openink Hub brings website development together with digital growth and automation capabilities.

Connect Your Website With CRM

Capture enquiries and organize customer information through connected lead management workflows.

Business automation services →

Automate Customer Communication

Explore WhatsApp Business API integrations and automated customer conversations to help your business respond more efficiently.

WhatsApp automation →

Generate and Manage Leads

Connect website enquiry forms with lead management and follow-up processes.

Talk to our team →

Strengthen Search Visibility

Combine website development with SEO, local SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI-driven optimization.

SEO services →Local SEO →AI optimization →

Improve Marketing Efficiency

Connect your website with relevant analytics, marketing tools, and automation workflows.

The objective is simple: build a website that can become a valuable part of your wider business ecosystem.

Process

Our Website Development Process

A successful website project needs more than coding. It requires planning, communication, design, development, and quality checks.

Step 1 – Understanding Your Business

We begin by understanding your business model, target audience, website goals, competitors, and functional requirements.

Step 2 – Website Planning and Structure

We plan the website architecture, navigation, content requirements, and key user journeys.

Step 3 – UI/UX Design

We develop the visual direction and user interface around your brand identity and customer experience requirements.

Step 4 – Website Development

Our development process brings the approved design and functionality together using the technology selected for your project. Responsive website development means every page adapts to phones, tablets, and desktops.

Step 5 – Testing and Quality Assurance

We review website functionality, responsiveness, navigation, forms, integrations, and essential technical configurations.

Step 6 – Launch and Handover

Once the website is approved, we coordinate deployment, domain configuration, and the agreed handover requirements.

Step 7 – Maintenance and Continuous Improvement

After launch, your website can be improved through maintenance, content updates, performance monitoring, security checks, and additional features.

Industries

Website Development for Different Industries

We understand that different industries need different website experiences.

Our website development solutions can be planned for:

  • Healthcare and medical businesses
  • Education and training institutes
  • Real estate companies
  • Manufacturing businesses
  • Retail and eCommerce brands
  • Professional service providers
  • Financial and consulting firms
  • Travel and hospitality businesses
  • Technology and SaaS companies
  • Startups and emerging businesses

Whether you need a simple business website or a more advanced digital platform, the solution should reflect how your customers search, evaluate, and interact with your business.

Why us

Why Choose Openink Hub for Website Development?

Development With a Business-First Approach

We focus on understanding your business objectives before recommending a website structure or technology.

Design and Functionality Together

A website should be visually engaging and easy to use. We consider both design quality and practical functionality.

SEO and AI Search Awareness

We consider SEO foundations, structured content, and AI discovery requirements as part of the broader website strategy.

Automation-Ready Solutions

Your website can be planned to connect with CRM systems, WhatsApp automation, lead management, and other business tools.

Scalable Development Approach

We consider future expansion when planning website architecture, functionality, and technology choices.

Connected Digital Growth Services

Openink Hub also provides SEO, local SEO, AI search optimization, WhatsApp automation, and other business automation solutions.

Pricing

Website Development Pricing

Website development cost depends on the scope and complexity of the project.

Starting prices for a standard business website on each technology stack:

Website stackStarting priceFramework and best useHostingServer requirements
WordPress websiteFrom ₹10,000*WordPress with a block theme or page builder, WooCommerce for stores. Best for business sites, blogs and small shops you want to edit yourself.Shared or managed WordPress hostingPHP 8.3 or newer, MySQL 8.0+ or MariaDB 10.6+, HTTPS
Astro static websiteFrom ₹25,000*Astro builds plain HTML pages with very little JavaScript. Best for fast brochure sites, landing pages and content sites.Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel or any static hostNode.js 22 LTS only to build the site; the live site needs no server software
Laravel websiteFrom ₹30,000*Laravel (PHP) with Blade templates and an admin panel. Best for portals, booking systems and sites with logins.VPS or Laravel-ready cloud hosting with SSH accessPHP 8.3 or newer, Composer, MySQL or PostgreSQL, cron for scheduled jobs
Next.js websiteFrom ₹35,000*Next.js (React) with server rendering and static pages, often with a headless CMS. Best for fast marketing sites that grow into web apps.Vercel, Cloudflare, or a Node.js VPS; a static export runs on any hostNode.js 20.9 or newer for server rendering; 1–2 GB RAM if self-hosted
MERN web applicationFrom ₹40,000*MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js. Best for dashboards, customer portals and custom tools with user accounts.Node.js VPS or cloud platform, with MongoDB Atlas or a managed databaseNode.js 22 LTS, MongoDB 7 or newer, 2 GB RAM or more, Nginx and PM2 on a VPS

WordPress suits most small businesses that want a website quickly. Astro, Laravel, Next.js and MERN suit projects that need more speed, custom features or user accounts. Hosting and domain costs depend on the provider you choose.

* Terms and conditions apply. Prices may vary and are subject to customised solutions. The final price depends on the number of pages required.

The final quotation may vary based on:

  • Number of website sections and templates
  • Design customization requirements
  • CMS or development framework
  • eCommerce functionality
  • Third-party integrations
  • Custom backend functionality
  • Content and migration requirements
  • Hosting and maintenance needs

We recommend discussing your requirements before selecting a development package. This helps establish a practical project scope and a transparent quotation.

Want to know how much your website will cost?

Request a Website Development Quote →

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions About Website Development

What does a website development agency do?

A website development agency plans, designs, builds, tests, and maintains websites and web applications. Its work may include frontend development, backend programming, CMS configuration, eCommerce functionality, integrations, and technical optimization.

How much does website development cost in India?

WordPress websites from Openink Hub start at ₹10,000. Custom stacks start higher: Astro static sites from ₹25,000, Laravel from ₹30,000, Next.js from ₹35,000 and MERN web applications from ₹40,000. The final quote depends on the number of pages, design work, features and integrations. Terms and conditions apply.

How long does it take to develop a website?

The timeline depends on project scope, design approvals, content readiness, integrations, and functionality. A relatively simple business website may take less time than a custom application or large eCommerce platform. A realistic timeline can be established after project discovery.

Will my website work on mobile devices?

Our website planning considers responsive layouts so the website can adapt to different screen sizes, including smartphones, tablets, and desktop devices.

Will my website be SEO-friendly?

We consider SEO fundamentals such as website structure, metadata, heading hierarchy, mobile usability, crawlability, indexability, and performance. Ongoing SEO campaigns and ranking improvements are separate activities that may be planned according to your goals.

Which technology is best for website development?

There is no single technology that is best for every website. WordPress may be appropriate for content-driven business websites, while React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, or other technologies may suit projects requiring custom functionality. The right choice depends on your requirements and long-term plans.

Can you develop an eCommerce website?

Yes. eCommerce projects can include product catalogues, categories, shopping carts, checkout processes, payment gateway integrations, and order management features, depending on the agreed project scope.

Can my website be connected to WhatsApp?

Yes. Depending on your requirements, your website can be connected to WhatsApp for customer enquiries, communication, lead capture, and automation using supported integration methods.

Can you redesign my existing website?

Yes. A redesign project can involve updating the visual design, improving navigation, restructuring content, optimizing mobile layouts, and modernizing technical components.

Do you provide website maintenance?

Website maintenance can be planned as a separate service. It may include software updates, backups, security checks, technical troubleshooting, content updates, and performance monitoring.

Can you develop a custom web application?

Yes. Custom web application projects can be evaluated based on their workflows, user roles, integrations, database requirements, security considerations, and functional specifications.

Why should I choose Openink Hub?

As a website development company, Openink Hub combines website development with digital growth and automation capabilities. This allows businesses to consider their website, search visibility, customer communication, and lead management as connected parts of their digital strategy.

Ready to Build a Website That Works for Your Business?

Your website is often the first meaningful interaction customers have with your brand. Make that interaction useful, professional, and easy to navigate.

Whether you need a new business website, a custom eCommerce platform, a website redesign, or a web application, Openink Hub can help you plan the right digital solution. Work with professional website developers who plan around your goals, not just your launch date.

Let's discuss your website development project.
